_comment: Words approved by hand for use even though they have not reached the 21-day interval in Anki. These are NOT known words — build.py marks every occurrence so the reader shows their furigana by default and underlines them. Each entry records which story needed it and why, so this list stays a deliberate short list rather than a second vocabulary.

時計の音.文字盤: watch dial — 表 was standing in for it
時計の音.秒針: second hand — 秒が進んでいた was the weakest phrase in the set

迷子の手紙.差出人: sender — 送った人 was the circumlocution

終電.明かり: lights (ambient) — 照明 is installed/stage lighting, wrong for a street

猫を探す探偵.飼い主: owner of an animal — 一緒に暮らしている人 was the biggest single loss in the drafts
猫を探す探偵.餌: animal food — 猫の食べ物 was the circumlocution
猫を探す探偵.首輪: collar — 首に赤い紐 was the circumlocution

城の鐘.王: king — 王様 is nursery-tale, 国王 is serviceable but 王 is the register the story wants
城の鐘.従う: to obey — the captain's creed depends on it
城の鐘.叫ぶ: to shout — the king's shout at the climax
城の鐘.段: counter for steps — 二百段 is the concrete detail 階段は長くて replaced
城の鐘.二百段: Ichiran parses this as one token, so 段 alone never matches — listed so the reader still marks it
